analyses.summary: One page carries two complete contracts effective 21 September 2026 — Snap Inc. for US users, Snap Group Limited for everyone else — and they grant materially different rights. Anything you post to Spotlight, Snap Map, a Public Profile or a Public Story is licensed to Snap, other users and its business partners on an unrestricted, irrevocable and perpetual basis for commercial purposes, covering the name, image, likeness and voice of anyone appearing in it, with no compensation; the US edition sets no end date at all while the non-US edition sunsets the licence but keeps server copies indefinitely. The content licence is one of the sections that expressly survives you deleting your account. US users get mandatory arbitration that reaches back to disputes arising before this version took effect, an opt-out that runs 30 days from when you first became subject to arbitration rather than from this update, a pre-arbitration demand that is void if it is filed on behalf of more than one person, a rule that makes you pay Snap's arbitration fees if you reject a settlement offer and do not beat it, and a liability cap of $100.

exposures.title: A perpetual, irrevocable commercial licence in your public content — and in the face of anyone in it
exposures.whatItMeans: Public Story submissions, Public Profiles, Spotlight, Snap Map and Lens Studio content are 'Public Content'. For it you grant Snap, its affiliates, every other user of the Services and Snap's business partners a licence to create derivative works, broadcast, syndicate, reproduce, distribute and publicly display it in any medium now known or later developed, for commercial and non-commercial purposes. The licence expressly extends to the separate sound recordings and musical compositions in it, and to the name, image, likeness and voice of anyone featured — not only you.
exposures.whyItMatters: The people whose faces are in your Spotlight video never agreed to anything; you granted the licence on their behalf. The terms state plainly that you will not be entitled to any compensation if that content, or your voice or likeness, is used by Snap, its affiliates, other users or its business partners.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 2. Rights You Grant Us
reference.quote: unrestricted, worldwide, royalty-free, irrevocable, and perpetual right and license

exposures.title: The licence outlives your account
exposures.whatItMeans: Section 16 lists the sections that survive termination of the Terms, whoever ends them, and Section 2 — the content licence — is the first one named. Deleting your Snapchat account ends your right to use the Services; it does not end Snap's rights in what you posted.
exposures.whyItMatters: The product's whole reputation rests on content that disappears. The contract governing it says the opposite about the rights you granted. The non-US edition is more explicit still: it sunsets the Public Content licence a reasonable period after you delete, then adds that Snap may keep server copies indefinitely.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 16. Termination and Suspension
reference.quote: continue to be bound by Sections 2, 3

exposures.title: Your My AI conversations are licensed content, not private messages
exposures.whatItMeans: Section 6 defines everything you type, say, photograph or upload to an AI feature as 'Inputs' and everything it produces as 'Outputs', then states that both are treated as content you submitted to the Services — so the worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable and transferable licence in Section 2 applies to them in full.
exposures.whyItMatters: A chat with My AI reads like a private message and is licensed like a post. The privacy policy separately confirms Snap's machine learning models take My AI conversations into account, and neither document offers a way to opt out of that while continuing to use the feature.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 6. AI Features
reference.quote: any rights and licenses granted to us and obligations on you in respect of content submitted or made available by you in these Terms applies to Inputs and Outputs

exposures.title: Arbitration that reaches backwards, with an opt-out that does not reopen
exposures.whatItMeans: The US arbitration agreement supersedes all prior versions and covers claims that arose before this version's effective date. The opt-out must be sent within 30 days of first becoming subject to arbitration — not 30 days from this update — by post to Santa Monica or by email to a dedicated address.
exposures.whyItMatters: Anyone who has had a Snapchat account for more than a month has already missed the window, and a new arbitration agreement they never had a chance to refuse now governs a dispute that predates it. Opting out of arbitration alone does not release you from the class action waiver, and you may not opt out of the class waiver at all.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 20a, 20k
reference.quote: also includes claims and disputes that arose between us before the effective date

exposures.title: A demand filed for more than one person is void for everyone on it
exposures.whatItMeans: Before arbitrating you must mail an individualised Pre-Arbitration Demand carrying your name, username, contact details, a description of the dispute and your signature, then wait 60 days. A demand covering multiple individuals is invalid as to all of them, compliance is a condition precedent, the arbitrator must dismiss any filing that did not fully comply, and Snap may go to court for a declaration that the arbitration should be dismissed on that ground.
exposures.whyItMatters: This is the mass-arbitration countermeasure in its cleanest form: the thousand people harmed by the same product decision cannot be processed together at any stage, and a defect in the paperwork kills the claim rather than pausing it.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 20b. Informal Dispute Resolution First
reference.quote: A Pre-Arbitration Demand brought on behalf of multiple individuals is invalid as to all

exposures.title: Turn down a settlement offer and lose, and you pay Snap's arbitration bill
exposures.whatItMeans: Either side may serve a written offer of judgment at least ten days before the hearing. If you refuse it and then fail to win more than it offered, you recover none of your own post-offer costs and must pay Snap's costs, including every fee Snap paid the arbitral forum.
exposures.whyItMatters: Snap can price a lowball offer at whatever it thinks a claimant will not dare refuse, because refusing converts a claim capped at $100 in recoverable damages into a personal liability for a corporate defendant's arbitration fees. No other document in this corpus shifts costs this way.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 20g. Settlement Offers and Offers of Judgement
reference.quote: shall not recover their post-offer costs and shall pay the offering party’s costs

exposures.title: Everything Snap could owe you is capped at $100
exposures.whatItMeans: Aggregate liability for all claims relating to the Services is the greater of $100 (EUR 100 outside the US) or what you paid Snap in the preceding 12 months. Indirect, incidental, consequential and punitive damages, lost data and lost goodwill are excluded outright, including for unauthorised access to or alteration of your content.
exposures.whyItMatters: Most Snapchatters pay Snap nothing, so the cap is $100 — for a service holding years of photographs, location history and private messages. The exclusion names unauthorised access to your content specifically, which is the failure most likely to actually harm you.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 19. Limitation of Liability
reference.quote: EXCEED THE GREATER OF $100 USD

exposures.title: You indemnify Snap without limit, including for services Snap recommended to you
exposures.whatItMeans: You must indemnify, defend and hold harmless Snap, its affiliates, directors, officers, stockholders, employees, licensors and agents against all claims, damages, losses, costs and attorneys' fees arising from your use of the Services, your content, your breach, or your negligence. The US edition extends this to products or services provided by a third party in connection with the Services even where Snap recommended, made available or approved them.
exposures.whyItMatters: Your liability to Snap is uncapped and Snap's to you is $100. The third-party extension means a Snap-endorsed integration that harms someone becomes your legal bill, not Snap's.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 17. Indemnity
reference.quote: even if recommended, made available, or approved by Snap

exposures.title: Giving Snap your phone number overrides the Do Not Call registry
exposures.whatItMeans: Providing a mobile number is agreement to receive messages from Snap about the Services, your account and promotions, and those messages may be sent even though the number is on a state or federal Do Not Call list or its international equivalent.
exposures.whyItMatters: A registry a person joined specifically to stop marketing contact is set aside by a term inside a service agreement. Both editions carry it, so this is not a US-only drafting quirk.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 13. Data Charges and Mobile Phones
reference.quote: even if your mobile phone number is registered on any state or federal Do Not Call list

exposures.title: Your account, username and content can go for any reason
exposures.whatItMeans: Snap may restrict, terminate or suspend access for non-compliance, for reasons outside its control, or for any other reason; may terminate for prolonged inactivity; and may reclaim your username at any time for any reason. It will try to give reasonable notice but cannot guarantee it. In the US edition Snap may also access, review, screen and delete your content at any time and for any reason, and will not be liable for doing so. Memories content may become unavailable and Snap recommends keeping your own copy.
exposures.whyItMatters: Notice and appeal are promised only where the action follows a Community Guidelines violation. Termination for 'any other reason' sits outside that promise, and the terms themselves advise backing up the storage product you paid attention to.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 16. Termination and Suspension
reference.quote: we may reclaim your username at any time for any reason

exposures.title: Snap will hand user content to EU authorities without contesting conflicts of law
exposures.whatItMeans: Section 10 of both editions states that on receiving a legally valid request from an EU government agency or court — including a European Production Order under the EU e-Evidence Regulation — Snap may route the requested information, which can include user content, through an EU affiliate without contesting potential conflicts of law.
exposures.whyItMatters: Conflict-of-law objections are the mechanism by which a provider resists an order from one jurisdiction that would breach protections in another. Snap tells you in advance it will not raise them, and the routing through an EU affiliate is what makes the order effective.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 10. Safety
reference.quote: without contesting potential conflicts of law

exposures.title: Two contracts on one page, and which one you get changes what you are owed
exposures.whatItMeans: The Snap Inc. and Snap Group Limited editions differ in substance, not just spelling. Non-US users get English courts rather than consumer arbitration, an express statement that nothing affects their statutory consumer rights, a Public Content licence with a defined end, a content-deletion right limited to violations and legal obligations, an account-security carve-out for activity outside their control, and a research carve-out under the EU Digital Services Act. US users get none of those and get the perpetual licence, the arbitration agreement and the class action waiver instead. Non-US users lose an explicit moral-rights waiver and a six-month deadline to complain about a moderation decision.
exposures.whyItMatters: The same product, the same day, the same page: whether you can sue in court, whether the licence in your photographs ever ends, and whether you are liable for a session you did not control all turn on your country of residence.

reference.label: Snap Group Limited Terms of Service — 11. Your Account
reference.quote: Except in the unlikely event that activity occurs in your account outside of your control

availableActions.action: Opt out of arbitration in writing within 30 days
availableActions.howTo: Email arbitration-opt-out@snap.com or post to Snap Inc., Attn: Arbitration Opt-out, 3000 31st Street, Santa Monica, CA 90405, with your name and address, Snapchat username, the email address on the account, and an unequivocal statement that you are opting out. Opting out of arbitration does not release you from the class action waiver, and the class action waiver cannot be opted out of on its own.

deadline.description: 30 days after first becoming subject to the Arbitration Agreement. The clause says 'first', and this version supersedes all prior versions rather than reopening the window, so an existing account's window has already closed.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 20k. Opt-out
reference.quote: no later than 30 days after first becoming subject to this Arbitration Agreement

availableActions.action: Treat Spotlight, Snap Map, Public Profile and Public Stories as the irreversible tier
availableActions.howTo: The perpetual, irrevocable, commercially exploitable licence attaches to Public Content specifically. Content sent to friends or saved to Memories carries the narrower operating licence. Choosing the audience before you post is the only point at which this is still a choice.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 2. Rights You Grant Us

availableActions.action: Do not put other people in Public Content
availableActions.howTo: The licence you grant covers the name, image, likeness and voice of anyone featured, including as reflected in their Bitmoji, and none of them are compensated. Ask before you post a friend to a public surface, because your acceptance binds their likeness.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 2. Rights You Grant Us
reference.quote: the name, image, likeness, and voice of anyone featured in Public Content

availableActions.action: Keep your own copies of anything in Memories
availableActions.howTo: The terms state Memories content may become unavailable through an operational glitch or a decision to terminate your account, make no promise about storage limits, and recommend keeping a separate copy. Use the Download My Data tool in the app periodically.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 12. Memories

availableActions.action: Appeal a moderation or account decision, and do it quickly if you are outside the US
availableActions.howTo: Snap commits to notify you and offer an appeal where the action follows a Community Guidelines violation, through the Moderation, Enforcement and Appeals Explainer. The non-US edition requires any complaint to be filed within six months of the action, and commits to reversing an incorrect decision and informing you of routes to redress.

deadline.description: Snap Group Limited edition only: complaints about action taken against your content or account must be submitted within six months of that action.

reference.label: Snap Group Limited Terms of Service — 7. Content Moderation
reference.quote: You must submit any complaints within six months

availableActions.action: Check which of the two contracts governs you before relying on anything in it
availableActions.howTo: One page carries both. US residence or principal place of business means Snap Inc., California law and the Central District of California; anywhere else means Snap Group Limited, the law of England and Wales and the English courts, with Snap Group Limited Singapore Branch as the contracting entity for India, Pakistan, Afghanistan and the Central Asian republics.

reference.label: Snap Terms of Service — entity selection

availableActions.action: Read the Paid Features Terms before subscribing to Snapchat+
availableActions.howTo: Section 3 pulls in additional terms for paid features and states that where they conflict with these Terms the additional terms override. Nothing about billing, renewal or refunds is settled in this document.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 3. Additional Terms and Policies That May Apply

availableActions.action: Delete the account knowing what deletion does not reach
availableActions.howTo: Deleting the account terminates the Terms and ends your licence to use the Services. Section 2 survives, so the rights you granted in content you already posted are unaffected, and the Public Content licence in the US edition has no end date.

reference.label: Snap Inc. Terms of Service — 16. Termination and Suspension

requiredDisclosures.name: Arbitration clause
requiredDisclosures.note: Prominent all-caps notice at the top of the US edition and a full Section 20: binding individual arbitration before ADR Services (NAM as fallback), jury waiver, class and consolidation waiver, arbitrability delegated to the arbitrator except for the class waiver, and survival beyond termination. Non-US consumers are not subject to it; only non-US business users are, under LCIA rules in London.

requiredDisclosures.name: Arbitration opt-out right
requiredDisclosures.note: Present and workable — 30 days, by email or post, with the required contents spelled out. The weakness is the word 'first': this version supersedes all prior arbitration agreements and reaches disputes arising before its effective date, but does not reopen the opt-out window on update. Compare OpenAI, which reopens its window on every update.

requiredDisclosures.name: Pre-arbitration dispute procedure
requiredDisclosures.note: Sixty days, by post to the Litigation Department in Santa Monica, with five mandatory contents including a signature. Compliance is a condition precedent and the arbitrator must dismiss non-compliant filings. A demand made on behalf of more than one individual is invalid as to all of them, which is the disclosure's substance working against the claimant rather than for them.

requiredDisclosures.name: Governing law and jurisdiction
requiredDisclosures.note: Fully specified in both editions: California law with exclusive venue in the Central District of California or LA Superior Court for US users; the law of England and Wales with the English courts for everyone else, subject to mandatory local law where the user resides.

requiredDisclosures.name: Notice of changes to terms
requiredDisclosures.note: Both editions commit to reasonable advance notice of material changes, with carve-outs for legally required changes and new features, and count continued use as acceptance. No number of days is given, so 'reasonable' is Snap's to judge. Stronger than the Privacy Policy's commitment, which is the notable thing — see the notice split between the two documents.

requiredDisclosures.name: Non-retroactivity of changes
requiredDisclosures.note: The opposite is stated. The Arbitration Agreement supersedes all prior versions and expressly covers claims and disputes that arose between the parties before this version's effective date, while the opt-out clock runs from first exposure to arbitration rather than from this change. LinkedIn's user agreement, by contrast, commits to non-retroactivity.

requiredDisclosures.name: Limitation on indemnity
requiredDisclosures.note: The indemnity is uncapped, covers attorneys' fees, extends to affiliates, stockholders, licensors and agents, and has no carve-out for loss caused by Snap's own act or omission. The US edition widens it further to third-party products and services Snap itself recommended or approved. Snap's reciprocal exposure to the user is capped at $100.

requiredDisclosures.name: Designated DMCA agent
requiredDisclosures.note: Named with a postal address and dedicated email — Snap Inc., Attn: Copyright Agent, 3000 31st Street, Santa Monica, CA 90405 — plus the full 17 U.S.C. 512(c)(3) notice requirements reproduced in both editions and a separate reporting tool for trademark claims.

requiredDisclosures.name: Repeat infringer policy
requiredDisclosures.note: States that where Snap becomes aware a user has repeatedly infringed copyrights it will take reasonable steps within its power to suspend or terminate the account. Qualified by 'reasonable steps' with no strike count or published threshold.

requiredDisclosures.name: Consumer complaint route
requiredDisclosures.note: Section 24 of the US edition gives the California Civil Code 1789.3 route in full — the Complaint Assistance Unit of the Division of Consumer Services, with postal address and telephone number. The non-US edition has no equivalent statutory complaint address.

requiredDisclosures.name: Company identification details
requiredDisclosures.note: Among the most complete in the corpus. Snap Inc. at 3000 31st Street, Santa Monica; Snap Group Limited at 50 Cowcross Street, London EC1M 6AL with company number 09763672 and VAT ID GB 237218316; Snap Group Limited Singapore Branch at Marina Bay Financial Centre Tower 3 with UEN T20FC0031F and VAT ID M90373075A, named as the contracting entity for India and seven other Asia-Pacific countries.

requiredDisclosures.name: Consumer rights preservation
requiredDisclosures.note: Present in the Snap Group Limited edition only, in capitals: nothing in the Terms affects the user's statutory rights as a consumer, plus non-excludable liability for death or personal injury and for fraud. The Snap Inc. edition carries no equivalent saving clause.

requiredDisclosures.name: Equal treatment regardless of jurisdiction
requiredDisclosures.note: The two editions on this single page diverge on the duration of the content licence, the grounds on which Snap may delete content, liability for account activity outside the user's control, the consumer-rights saving clause, and whether disputes go to a court or to arbitration with a class waiver. Which set you receive is decided by residence.

requiredDisclosures.name: Children under 13
requiredDisclosures.note: Both editions state the Services are not directed to under-13s, require confirmation of age at signup, and commit to ceasing service and locking or deleting the account and data on actual knowledge. The standard is actual knowledge rather than reasonable belief, and 'we may require you to verify your age' is permissive. Set against Section 2, which requires only that Public Content be appropriate for people aged 13+ while licensing the likeness of anyone in it to Snap's business partners for commercial use without compensation.

requiredDisclosures.name: Minimum age
requiredDisclosures.note: Thirteen, or the higher local minimum where one applies, stated in the summary, in Section 1 and in the Section 1 summary of both editions, with notice that some Services require 18.

analyses.summary: TikTok's US privacy policy describes the broadest collection in this corpus. It takes biometric identifiers — faceprints and voiceprints — from your videos, records your keystroke patterns and rhythms, reads your clipboard, follows you through its in-app browser onto other websites, and collects content at the moment you create it whether or not you ever publish it. Consent for the biometrics is sought only where the law requires it.

exposures.title: Faceprints and voiceprints are taken from your videos
exposures.whatItMeans: Content characteristics collected include the existence and location of a face and other body parts, the text of words spoken, and biometric identifiers and biometric information as defined under US law, such as faceprints and voiceprints. Permission is sought only where required by law.
exposures.whyItMatters: Biometrics cannot be changed after a breach and identify you across any system holding them. Conditioning consent on legal requirement means most users in most states are never asked.

reference.label: Content characteristics and features
reference.quote: We may collect biometric identifiers and biometric information as defined under US laws, such as faceprints and voiceprints, from your user content. Where required by law, we will seek any required permissions from you prior to any such collection.

exposures.title: Content you never published is collected anyway
exposures.whatItMeans: User content may be collected by pre-uploading at the time of creation, import or upload, regardless of whether you choose to save or publish it.
exposures.whyItMatters: The video you recorded and deleted before posting was already uploaded. Deciding not to publish is the moment most people believe they retained control, and this states plainly that they did not.

reference.label: User content
reference.quote: We may collect user content through pre-uploading at the time of creation, import, or upload, regardless of whether you choose to save or publish that user content

exposures.title: Your typing rhythm is a recorded identifier
exposures.whatItMeans: Automatically collected technical information includes keystroke patterns or rhythms, alongside device IDs and user IDs used to identify your activity across devices.
exposures.whyItMatters: Keystroke dynamics are a behavioural biometric: they can identify the same person on a different account or a different device, which defeats the usual protection of starting fresh.

reference.label: Technical information from your device, network, and application

exposures.title: Clipboard contents are read
exposures.whatItMeans: Text and images accessed through your device's clipboard are collected when you use certain functions such as sharing to third-party services or pasting into the app.
exposures.whyItMatters: A clipboard commonly holds passwords, one-time codes, addresses and text copied from entirely unrelated apps.

exposures.title: The in-app browser watches what you do on other sites
exposures.whatItMeans: Usage information includes certain information about your interactions with websites when you use the in-app browser.
exposures.whyItMatters: Tapping a link inside TikTok puts your browsing inside TikTok's collection rather than your own browser's, and most people cannot tell which one they are in.

exposures.title: Messages and AI conversations are scanned and reviewed
exposures.whatItMeans: Information is used to train, test and improve machine learning models by scanning, analysing and reviewing user content, messages, AI interactions and associated metadata — and again for enforcement purposes.
exposures.whyItMatters: Private messages and AI prompts are named alongside public content as training and review material, so nothing in the product is outside that scope.

exposures.title: People who are not users are still in the data
exposures.whatItMeans: Information about you may appear in user content created or published by others even if you are not a user, and contact syncing collects names, phone numbers and email addresses from other people's phone books.
exposures.whyItMatters: Non-users have no account, no settings and no route to the controls described in this policy.

exposures.title: Do Not Track signals are ignored and there is no retention limit
exposures.whatItMeans: The policy states it does not act on browser do-not-track signals, and retention is described by criteria rather than any period.
exposures.whyItMatters: Cookie choices must be repeated per browser, and no category of the data above has a stated end date.

availableActions.action: Never use the in-app browser
availableActions.howTo: Open links in your own browser instead. This is the single change that removes the largest collection surface described in the policy, and it needs no settings change.

availableActions.action: Refuse contacts access in device settings
availableActions.howTo: The policy notes your device may have controls determining what is collected and names phone contacts specifically. Denying it protects people who are not users and cannot protect themselves.

availableActions.action: Manage ads settings in-app, and by webform if you have no account
availableActions.howTo: In-app settings under 'Ads' control how activity elsewhere online is used, and how TikTok Ad Network serves you ads on other sites. If you have no TikTok account, a separate webform covers the Ad Network.

availableActions.action: Request access, correction or deletion, and appeal a refusal
availableActions.howTo: Requests can be made in-app or by post, an authorised agent can act for you with power of attorney, and any decision can be appealed by the same routes.

availableActions.action: If you are a Californian under 18, request removal of your posts
availableActions.howTo: Under-18 California residents can require removal of content they posted. Connecticut residents aged 13 to 17, and guardians of under-16s, can require their account be unpublished or deleted.

requiredDisclosures.name: Biometric information consent
requiredDisclosures.note: Collection of faceprints and voiceprints is disclosed, but consent is conditioned on legal requirement — 'where required by law' — rather than sought as a matter of course. Only some US states impose that requirement.

requiredDisclosures.name: Sensitive personal information categories
requiredDisclosures.note: Categories are enumerated explicitly, including health diagnosis, sexual orientation, transgender or nonbinary status, immigration status and financial information, with a note that TikTok does not require them.

requiredDisclosures.name: Shine the Light disclosure
requiredDisclosures.note: California residents may request annual information about personal data shared with other businesses for their own direct marketing.

requiredDisclosures.name: Children under 13
requiredDisclosures.note: A separate limited experience and separate Children's Privacy Policy, with guardian rights to delete or download a child's data.

requiredDisclosures.name: Retention period
requiredDisclosures.note: Criteria are described but no period is stated for any category, including the biometric identifiers.

requiredDisclosures.name: Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information
requiredDisclosures.note: States it does not sell personal information or share it for cross-context behavioural advertising — but qualified with 'where restricted by applicable law', so the commitment tracks the legal floor rather than exceeding it.

analyses.summary: PhonePe's privacy policy is detailed and in several respects careful — Aadhaar is optional with named alternatives, e-KYC consent is revocable, data stays in India, account deletion is self-service, and it promises never to weaken protections for data already shared. Against that: it reads the SMS on your device, pulls your credit bureau file, spreads one profile across six named financial subsidiaries, and has you authorise marketing calls and emails regardless of your registration on India's Do Not Disturb registries.

exposures.title: You authorise calls and emails despite being on the DND registry
exposures.whatItMeans: By using the platform you agree and authorise PhonePe to communicate with you by phone call and email for the purposes in the policy, irrespective of your registration with any authorised Do Not Disturb registry.
exposures.whyItMatters: The DND registry is a statutory protection a person opted into deliberately. This contracts around it by consent inferred from use, and it is the only clause of its kind in this corpus.

reference.label: Your Consent
reference.quote: you agree and authorize PhonePe to communicate with you via channels like Phone calls and E-mail for the purposes set out in this policy, irrespective of your registration with any authorized DND registries

exposures.title: The app reads the SMS stored on your device
exposures.whatItMeans: Collected information includes the SMS messages stored on your device, for registration, OTPs, security, bill payment and recharge reminders, and 'any other legitimate uses with your explicit consent'.
exposures.whyItMatters: Your message store contains banking alerts, personal conversations and messages from people who never agreed to anything. The stated purposes end with an open category, so the boundary is not fixed by this document.

exposures.title: Your credit file is pulled, and lending partners pull it again
exposures.whatItMeans: PhonePe collects credit reports, credit scores and related information from credit bureaus, and shares information with banks, non-banking financial companies and credit bureaus for lending journeys — noting those partners may themselves pull your credit information for eligibility and risk assessment.
exposures.whyItMatters: A payments app becomes the front door to multiple credit assessments, and the policy describes the partners' own bureau pulls as something that happens rather than something you separately authorise here.

exposures.title: One profile spans six financial subsidiaries
exposures.whatItMeans: The policy covers PhonePe plus Insurance Broking, Wealth Broking, Lending Services, Technology Services, Pincode Shopping Solutions and PhonePe Finance, and states your profile information will be common across PhonePe apps.
exposures.whyItMatters: Insurance, investment, lending and shopping data are combined under one consent. Information given for a payment can inform an insurance or credit decision without a separate decision by you.

exposures.title: Health and lifestyle data is collected for health tracking
exposures.whatItMeans: Health and lifestyle-related information including physical activity is collected when you opt for health-tracking services.
exposures.whyItMatters: It sits in the same profile as the insurance subsidiary's data, and the policy does not separate its handling or sharing from the rest.

exposures.title: Investigations may run outside India
exposures.whatItMeans: Information may be shared with PhonePe's internal investigation department or agencies it appoints, located within or outside Indian jurisdiction, and forensic audits may involve government agencies inside or outside India.
exposures.whyItMatters: It is a stated exception to the otherwise firm data-localisation position, and the recipients are described by role rather than named.

exposures.title: The policy can change without any notice
exposures.whatItMeans: PhonePe reserves the right at its sole discretion to change the policy at any time without prior written notice; it may reasonably endeavour to notify you, but reviewing it is your responsibility, and continued use is acceptance.
exposures.whyItMatters: 'Reasonably endeavour' is not a commitment. The countervailing promise — never to make changes less protective of data already shared — is real and limits how far a silent change can reach.

availableActions.action: Use Voter ID or driving licence instead of Aadhaar
availableActions.howTo: The policy states plainly that submitting Aadhaar is not mandatory and names alternatives. That disclosure is clearer than most Indian financial policies in this corpus.

reference.label: Information Collection
reference.quote: Note that submission of Aadhaar information is not mandatory and there are alternatives to submission of identity information (e.g., Voter ID, DL)

availableActions.action: Revoke e-KYC consent for stored Aadhaar data
availableActions.howTo: Consent to store e-KYC information can be revoked at any time by writing in. You may lose access to services obtained on the basis of that consent, and some retention continues under the retention section.

availableActions.action: Deny SMS permission at the operating-system level
availableActions.howTo: SMS reading is a device permission. OTP autofill will stop working, but Android and iOS both allow OTP entry by hand.

availableActions.action: Delete your account from the Help section
availableActions.howTo: Account and personal information deletion is self-service through Help on the platform, subject to legally required retention.

availableActions.action: Do not opt into health tracking if you use the insurance products
availableActions.howTo: Health and physical activity data enters the same profile shared across the six named subsidiaries, one of which is an insurance broker.

requiredDisclosures.name: Aadhaar Act compliance and alternatives
requiredDisclosures.note: Names the Aadhaar Act and Regulations, states Aadhaar is optional, lists alternatives, and describes the CIDR and NSDL authentication path and the security controls applied.

requiredDisclosures.name: Data localisation
requiredDisclosures.note: States personal information is stored within India, with an explicit exception for investigation agencies located outside Indian jurisdiction.

requiredDisclosures.name: Commitment not to weaken protections retroactively
requiredDisclosures.note: Commits never to change the policy to be less protective of personal information already shared.

requiredDisclosures.name: Named Grievance Officer
requiredDisclosures.note: India's IT Rules require a named grievance officer with contact details and a stated resolution timeline. The policy gives a generic support link to a 'Privacy Officer' with no name, no direct address and only a 'reasonable time limit'.

requiredDisclosures.name: Retention period
requiredDisclosures.note: No period is stated. Retention is bounded by purpose with open-ended exceptions for fraud prevention, legal proceedings and 'other legitimate purposes'.

requiredDisclosures.name: Consent withdrawal for non-Aadhaar processing
requiredDisclosures.note: e-KYC consent is revocable and marketing messages can be unsubscribed, but no route is described to withdraw consent for credit-bureau, cross-subsidiary or lending-partner sharing.

analyses.summary: The largest document in this corpus, and it contains the lowest liability cap in it: Paytm's total liability for anything is the amount you paid for the service in question or ₹5,000, whichever is less. Whichever is less. Arbitration is Paytm's option and not yours — it may elect binding individual arbitration in New Delhi, confidential, with administrative costs split equally, which for a consumer costs more than the ₹5,000 ceiling on what they could recover. Terms change on a 24-hour clock and are deemed accepted. You authorise Paytm to override your Do Not Disturb settings and to share your name and number with third parties for marketing. Any idea you send is irrevocably assigned to Paytm. Prepaid recharges are final with no refund, and a recharge sent to a mistyped number is your loss. The page carries every product's terms at once — wallet, bill payments, movies, buses, flights, gold, silver — and the only named grievance officer in 294,000 characters belongs to a third-party silver vendor.

exposures.title: Total liability is ₹5,000 or what you paid, whichever is less
exposures.whatItMeans: For any damages, liabilities, losses or causes of action arising from the agreement, the platform, any Paytm service, or your inability to use them — however caused, including in negligence — Paytm's liability cannot exceed the amount you paid for the portion of the service giving rise to the claim, or ₹5,000, whichever is less.
exposures.whyItMatters: This is a payments company operating a wallet, bill payments, ticketing and gold custody. 'Whichever is less' means a customer who paid a small convenience fee has their recovery capped at that fee, not at ₹5,000. It is the lowest cap in this corpus by a wide margin — Apple's is US$100 and Uber's is €500.

reference.label: Limitation of Liability and Damages
reference.quote: beyond or in excess of the amount paid by You, if any, for using the portion of the Paytm Service or the Paytm Platform giving rise to the cause of action, or beyond or in excess Rs. 5,000, whichever is less

exposures.title: Arbitration is Paytm's option, not a mutual one — and it costs more than you can win
exposures.whatItMeans: After 30 days of unsuccessful amicable resolution, Paytm may elect binding arbitration under the Indian Arbitration and Conciliation Act. It is arbitrated individually and may not be consolidated with any other party's claim, the seat is New Delhi, the proceeding is confidential, and all administrative fees and expenses are divided equally between you and Paytm with each side bearing its own lawyers.
exposures.whyItMatters: Every arbitration clause in this corpus binds both sides; this one is an election Paytm holds and the consumer does not. Paired with the ₹5,000 cap, the economics close the route entirely: half the arbitrator's fees exceed the maximum recoverable amount, so pursuing a claim costs more than winning it.

reference.label: Dispute Resolution
reference.quote: Paytm may elect to resolve any Dispute by a binding arbitration in accordance with the provisions of the Indian Arbitration & Conciliation Act, 1996

exposures.title: Arbitration is confidential, so no consumer can learn what happened to anyone else
exposures.whatItMeans: Neither party may disclose the existence, content or results of any arbitration, except as required by law or to enforce the award. Claims may not be consolidated with any other party's.
exposures.whyItMatters: Confidentiality plus a bar on consolidation means a systemic problem affecting thousands of wallet users produces no public record and no way for those users to find each other. The secrecy is what makes the individual-only rule bite.

reference.label: Dispute Resolution
reference.quote: Any arbitration shall be confidential, and neither You nor Paytm may disclose the existence, content or results of any arbitration

exposures.title: You authorise Paytm to override your Do Not Disturb registration
exposures.whatItMeans: Under the communication policy you authorise Paytm and Paytm Entities to override the DND settings to reach you by call, SMS, email and any other mode of communication. You separately authorise Paytm to share your data, including name and mobile number, with third parties and service providers for marketing and promotional purposes.
exposures.whyItMatters: India's Do Not Disturb registry is a regulator-run opt-out from marketing calls. This is the third document in the corpus to claim it can be overridden by a term of use, after PhonePe and MakeMyTrip — enough repetitions to make it a sector practice rather than one company's drafting.

reference.label: Communication Policy
reference.quote: You authorize Paytm and Paytm Entities to override the DND settings to reach out to You over calls, SMS, emails and any other mode of communication.

exposures.title: Changes are deemed accepted 24 hours after posting
exposures.whatItMeans: Paytm may change, add or remove parts of the agreement at any time by posting notification on the platform or otherwise communicating it. The changes become effective and are deemed accepted by you 24 hours after the initial posting. Your sole and exclusive remedy if you disagree is to stop using the services. Separately, terms for individual Paytm services may be changed at any time without notice.
exposures.whyItMatters: A 24-hour deemed-acceptance window on a wallet holding your money is the shortest in this corpus by an order of magnitude — PayPal commits to fourteen days, HDFC and Amazon to thirty. The service-specific clause is worse still, because it commits to nothing at all.

reference.label: Modification of this Agreement
reference.quote: The changes will become effective, and shall be deemed accepted by You, 24 hours after the initial posting

exposures.title: Any idea you send is irrevocably assigned to Paytm
exposures.whatItMeans: The terms invite comments and improvement suggestions to customer service, then state that by sending them you irrevocably assign to Paytm all rights, title and interest in every idea and suggestion and all associated worldwide intellectual property rights, and agree to sign whatever documents are needed to perfect that assignment.
exposures.whyItMatters: Assignment goes further than the licences elsewhere in this corpus — you do not merely permit use, you cease to own it. This is the fourth independent instance of the same Indian boilerplate, after HDFC Bank, American Express India and Zomato.

reference.label: Ownership; Proprietary Rights
reference.quote: You hereby irrevocably assign to Paytm, and shall assign to Paytm, all rights, title and interests in and to all ideas and suggestions and any and all worldwide intellectual property rights associated therewith

exposures.title: Recharges are final, and a mistyped number is your loss
exposures.whatItMeans: All prepaid recharge sales are final with no refund or exchange permitted. You are responsible for the mobile, DTH, data card or toll-tag number you enter and all resulting charges, and Paytm states it is not responsible for a recharge sent to an incorrect number. Where money was taken and no recharge was delivered within 24 hours, a refund follows investigation within 21 working days, then a further 3 to 21 working days to reach the bank.
exposures.whyItMatters: A single mistyped digit sends money to a stranger's phone with no recovery route. The failure case Paytm does cover — money taken, nothing delivered — can take six weeks to reverse.

reference.label: Refund Policy
reference.quote: All sales of prepaid recharge on the Paytm Platform are final with no refund or exchange permitted.

exposures.title: One login opens every Paytm platform, and their terms apply too
exposures.whatItMeans: The single-sign-on ID logs you into every participating Paytm and affiliate platform without a further login, and the set of participating platforms may vary over time. Each participating platform may have its own commercial and user terms, which apply alongside these. Paytm is entitled to reject individual users without giving reasons.
exposures.whyItMatters: The list of services your credentials open can grow after you registered, and each addition brings its own contract that you accept by using it. Nothing here requires you to be told when the list changes.

exposures.title: Airline refunds may come back as credit you can only spend with that airline
exposures.whatItMeans: Refunds are processed only after Paytm receives them from the airline and follow the airline's fare rules. Where the airline refunds as a credit for future bookings, Paytm will reflect it against your account, and it states that in no event will it refund you in cash where the airline's refund came as a credit. On a no-show you may claim back airport tax, less Paytm's convenience fee.
exposures.whyItMatters: Money paid in cash can come back as a voucher locked to one airline, with the platform expressly declining to bridge the difference — and the convenience fee is deducted from the residue either way.

exposures.title: Fee changes take effect the moment they are posted
exposures.whatItMeans: Paytm and its bill-payment partners reserve the right to charge and recover fees for the service, effective from the time they are posted on the platform or on the partner's own channel. You are stated to be bound by such revisions and told to visit the platform to review the applicable fees.
exposures.whyItMatters: Fees can change on a partner's website rather than Paytm's, and take effect on posting there. The customer is bound by a price published somewhere they were never directed to look.

exposures.title: Gold and silver terms change on posting, with the customer made responsible for checking
exposures.whatItMeans: For Paytm Gold, MMTC-PAMP reserves the right to change the terms at any time, effective when posted and deemed notified, with the customer responsible for regularly reviewing them and deemed to accept by continuing to use the platform. Gold cannot be bought and redeemed on the same day, redemption in physical form carries additional making and delivery charges, and the catalogue of redeemable products may be altered at the seller's sole discretion.
exposures.whyItMatters: This is stored value in a precious metal held by a custodian, governed by terms that can change without notice while the holding sits there. Title vests with you, but the terms on which you can get it out do not.

availableActions.action: Report an undelivered recharge within 24 hours
availableActions.howTo: If money was charged and the recharge has not arrived within 24 hours, contact customer service on the platform with the mobile, DTH, data card or toll-tag number, operator name, recharge value, transaction date and order number. A verified refund takes 21 working days to process, then 3 to 21 more to reach the bank.

deadline.description: Report within 24 hours of the transaction if the recharge has not been delivered.

availableActions.action: Check the number twice — recharges cannot be reversed
availableActions.howTo: All recharge sales are final and Paytm accepts no responsibility for a recharge sent to an incorrect mobile, DTH, data card or toll-tag number. There is no described route to recover money sent to the wrong number.

availableActions.action: Update your registered number before you surrender it
availableActions.howTo: If the mobile number or email on your account is transferred, surrendered or deactivated, the terms make it your responsibility to contact Paytm and have it updated first — and state that if you do not, Paytm is not liable for any misuse of your account. Do this before the number goes, not after.

availableActions.action: Use the 30-day amicable window — it is the only stage that costs you nothing
availableActions.howTo: Disputes must first go through 30 days of reasonable efforts to resolve amicably. Only after that can Paytm elect arbitration. Given that the recoverable maximum is ₹5,000 and arbitration costs are split equally, this window is realistically the whole of your remedy. Put the claim in writing and keep the record.

deadline.description: 30 days from notice of the dispute before either party may move to arbitration.

availableActions.action: Consider consumer forums rather than the contractual route
availableActions.howTo: Indian consumer protection law provides forums that this agreement does not displace, and the terms elsewhere accept that applicable law may not permit the full exclusion of liability. For a claim worth more than ₹5,000 against a payments company, that route is likely worth more than the one written here.

availableActions.action: Do not send Paytm your ideas
availableActions.howTo: Anything you send as a comment or improvement suggestion is irrevocably assigned to Paytm along with all worldwide intellectual property rights, and you agree to execute documents to perfect that assignment. Report bugs; keep ideas.

availableActions.action: Escalate silver transactions through the only named grievance chain in the document
availableActions.howTo: For ZariVault silver, a three-tier route exists: customer support, then a Grievance Officer if unresolved within 15 working days, then a Nodal Officer in writing at the registered office beyond 30 days. No equivalent named chain is given for Paytm's own services anywhere in this 294,000-character page.

deadline.description: Escalate to the Grievance Officer if unresolved within 15 working days; to the Nodal Officer beyond 30 days.

reference.label: MMTC - PAMP Terms and Conditions - Silver

availableActions.action: Send formal notice by courier or registered post
availableActions.howTo: Notice to Paytm must be sent by courier or registered mail to One97 Communications Ltd., B-121, Sector-5, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301. In-app messages do not constitute notice under the agreement, so anything you need to prove you sent should go this way.

availableActions.action: Expect airline refunds as credit, and cancel through Paytm not the airline
availableActions.howTo: Refund requests must be raised with Paytm, and cancellations made directly with the airline must still be reported to Paytm to start the process. Where the airline refunds as a credit, you get a credit — Paytm states it will never convert that to cash.

availableActions.action: Redeem gold on a different day from buying it, and price in the extra charges
availableActions.howTo: Gold cannot be bought and redeemed the same day. Physical redemption starts at one gram and carries making, delivery and tax charges on top; residual fractional gold can be sold back at the live 995 24K sell-back price. Check the redeemable-product catalogue before buying, since it can be altered at the seller's discretion.

requiredDisclosures.name: Named Grievance Officer
requiredDisclosures.note: In 294,000 characters covering the wallet, bill payments, ticketing, gold and silver, the only named grievance and nodal officers belong to ZariVault, a third-party silver vendor. Paytm — a regulated payment system operator and an intermediary under the IT Rules — names none of its own, giving only a Help & Support section and a postal address for legal notice.

requiredDisclosures.name: Notice of changes to terms
requiredDisclosures.note: Deemed acceptance 24 hours after posting for the main agreement, and service-specific terms may be changed 'at any time, without notice'. The clause acknowledges that applicable law may require advance notice for certain changes, which is the only floor.

requiredDisclosures.name: Governing law and jurisdiction
requiredDisclosures.note: Indian law with New Delhi courts, subject to an arbitration clause that only Paytm may invoke. Individual arbitration only, no consolidation, confidential, seat New Delhi, administrative costs split equally.

requiredDisclosures.name: Refund and cancellation rights
requiredDisclosures.note: Disclosed per product and largely adverse: recharges final and non-refundable, refunds for undelivered recharges taking up to 21 working days plus bank time, airline refunds contingent on receipt from the airline and payable as credit where the airline gives credit.

requiredDisclosures.name: Consent withdrawal mechanism
requiredDisclosures.note: The communication policy takes authorisation to override DND settings and to share your name and mobile number with third parties for marketing, with no described route to withdraw either.

requiredDisclosures.name: Company identification details
requiredDisclosures.note: One97 Communications Limited, with registered office at First Floor Devika Tower, Nehru Place, New Delhi 110019 and headquarters at B-121, Sector-5, Noida 201301.

requiredDisclosures.name: Pre-arbitration dispute procedure
requiredDisclosures.note: 30 days of reasonable endeavours to resolve amicably from notice of the dispute, before Paytm may elect arbitration.

requiredDisclosures.name: Limitation on indemnity
requiredDisclosures.note: The indemnity covers use or misuse of the services, any violation of the agreement, and any breach of your representations, with Paytm entitled to assume exclusive defence and settlement at your expense. No carve-out for Paytm's own negligence, fraud or misconduct — unlike DoorDash's equivalent clause.

requiredDisclosures.name: Consumer rights preservation
requiredDisclosures.note: A single acknowledgement that applicable law may not permit the full limitation or exclusion of liability, in which case liability is limited to the fullest extent the law allows. No reference to the Consumer Protection Act 2019 or its forums anywhere in the document.

analyses.summary: Placing an order on Zomato is defined as an unconditional and irrevocable authorisation, which makes cancelling it a breach — and the penalty is liquidated damages equal to the order value, deducted from your next order. Being unreachable or mistyping your address counts. No refund of any kind is given without the restaurant's permission, and the platform fee is never refunded. Personal injury and property damage are not capped but excluded outright, and any legal action must be brought within one year or is barred forever. Terms change with no notice at all: you are told to check the page yourself. Set against that, the grievance disclosure is the best in this corpus — a Grievance Officer and a Nodal Officer, both named, with postal addresses, emails, phone numbers and office hours.

exposures.title: Cancelling an order is a breach, and the penalty is the whole order value
exposures.whatItMeans: Your order is defined as an unconditional and irrevocable authorisation for Zomato to order on your behalf. Cancelling it — or an order failing because you gave wrong details, were unresponsive, or were not available — is an 'Authorization Breach', and you become liable for liquidated damages equal to each component of the order value attributable to the restaurant, the delivery partner and any other party. Zomato is authorised to collect it by deducting it from your next order.
exposures.whyItMatters: Missing a phone call from the courier makes you liable for the full price of food you never received, collected without any further step by taking it out of the next thing you buy. The construction is what makes it work: by calling the order irrevocable, an ordinary cancellation becomes a contractual breach.

reference.label: Liquidated Damages
reference.quote: you shall be liable to pay the liquidated damages of an amount equivalent to each component of the order value... by deducting such amount from any payment made towards your next Order

exposures.title: Personal injury and property damage are excluded, not capped
exposures.whatItMeans: Both the warranty disclaimer and the limitation of liability state that Zomato assumes no responsibility and shall not be liable for personal injury or property damage of any nature whatsoever resulting from your access to and use of the services. Zomato also disclaims any warranty that the services have been provided with due skill, care and diligence. No monetary cap is stated, because there is no residual liability to cap.
exposures.whyItMatters: This is a food business. Personal injury from food is the foreseeable harm, and it is the harm named in the exclusion. Uber's terms cap personal injury at €500 and that was the worst in the corpus; excluding the category outright with no floor is stronger still.

reference.label: Limitation of Liability
reference.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL THE ZOMATO PARTIES BE LIABLE TO YOU FOR ANY DAMAGES RESULTING FROM... PERSONAL INJURY OR PROPERTY DAMAGE, OF ANY NATURE WHATSOEVER

exposures.title: You have one year to sue, whatever the law says
exposures.whatItMeans: Legal action must be commenced within one year after the alleged harm initially occurs, and the clause states that failure to do so bars any claim on the same facts forever, notwithstanding any statute of limitations to the contrary. It applies to all customers in every jurisdiction.
exposures.whyItMatters: India's Limitation Act gives three years for a contract claim. This contracts it to one by agreement, and the clock starts when the harm occurs rather than when you discover it — which matters most for exactly the harms that surface late.

reference.label: Governing Law/Waiver
reference.quote: YOU MUST COMMENCE ANY LEGAL ACTION AGAINST US WITHIN ONE (1) YEAR AFTER THE ALLEGED HARM INITIALLY OCCURS

exposures.title: No refund of any kind without the restaurant's permission
exposures.whatItMeans: The cancellation and refund policy opens by stating that no replacement, refund or any other resolution will be provided without the restaurant partner's permission. Complaints — spillage, foreign objects in the food, the wrong order, poor quality — require you to supply proof before any resolution is considered. Platform Service charges are never refunded except where Zomato itself cancels.
exposures.whyItMatters: The party that gets to veto your refund is the one whose mistake you are complaining about. Zomato positions itself as an intermediary with no liability for the restaurant's acts, so the only party who owes you anything is the one holding the veto.

reference.label: Cancellation and refund policy
reference.quote: No replacement / refund / or any other resolution will be provided without Restaurant Partner's permission.

exposures.title: Terms change with no notice — checking the page is your job
exposures.whatItMeans: Zomato may vary, amend, change or update the terms at any time entirely at its own discretion. You are made responsible for checking them from time to time, and any use of the platform after a change is deemed express acceptance of it.
exposures.whyItMatters: No email, no banner, no notice period, no effective date for the change. Every other document in this corpus commits to something — Amazon and HDFC to thirty days, PayPal to fourteen. This commits to nothing, and every clause above can be rewritten under it.

reference.label: Changes to the terms
reference.quote: You shall be responsible for checking these Terms from time to time and ensure continued compliance with these Terms.

exposures.title: You owe the delivery surge whether or not you were told about it
exposures.whatItMeans: Delivery charges and a separately calculated delivery surge vary per order on factors including distance, traffic, weather and demand. Zomato says it will inform you of the charges — using 'reasonable efforts' for the surge — and then states that you are responsible for them regardless of your awareness.
exposures.whyItMatters: The disclosure obligation and the payment obligation are decoupled in the same sentence. A price term you are liable for without having been told is the definition of a charge you cannot shop against.

reference.label: Food Ordering and Delivery
reference.quote: you will be responsible for the Delivery Surge incurred for your order regardless of your awareness of such Delivery Surge

exposures.title: A perpetual, irrevocable licence to your reviews, resold through API partnerships
exposures.whatItMeans: Submitting content grants Zomato a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, assignable, sublicensable and transferable licence to use it for any purpose, expressly including API partnerships with third parties, and to let those third parties' users do the same. 'Use' is defined to include commercialise. You irrevocably waive all moral rights and attribution claims.
exposures.whyItMatters: Reviews you wrote as a customer become inventory that can be licensed onward to businesses you have never heard of, in perpetuity, with your name attached and no right to be credited or to object.

reference.label: Zomato License to Your or Customer Content
reference.quote: a perpetual, irrevocable, world-wide, non-exclusive, fully paid and royalty-free, assignable, sub-licensable and transferable license to use Your Content... for any purpose including API partnerships with third parties

exposures.title: Any idea you send becomes Zomato's property, with no compensation
exposures.whatItMeans: Zomato asks you not to send unsolicited ideas, then sets out what happens if you do anyway: your submissions and their contents automatically become Zomato's property without any compensation to you, usable and redistributable for any purpose, with no obligation to review them or keep them confidential. Ordinary feedback separately carries a perpetual global licence and a waiver of all claims.
exposures.whyItMatters: This is the third independent instance of the same Indian boilerplate in the corpus, after HDFC Bank and American Express India — enough repetitions to make it the vertical norm a peer baseline measures against rather than one company's overreach.

reference.label: Terms of Idea Submission
reference.quote: your Submissions and their Contents will automatically become the property of Zomato, without any compensation to you

exposures.title: Zomato Gold can be withdrawn at any time with no notice and no refund
exposures.whatItMeans: The membership fee is non-transferable and non-refundable. Zomato may terminate or suspend membership at its sole discretion for conduct it considers a violation, with no refund. It may add exclusion days on which benefits do not apply, change the partner restaurant list, levy a surge fee on Gold orders, and terminate the whole programme at any time with immediate effect and without prior notice. Liability for anything relating to Gold is capped at the membership fee you paid.
exposures.whyItMatters: Every variable that determines whether the membership is worth its price — which restaurants, which days, what surge — can be changed after you have paid, and the fee is not refundable when they are.

reference.label: Zomato Gold
reference.quote: Zomato reserves the right to terminate the Zomato Gold program at any time, with immediate effect, at its sole discretion without giving any prior notice.

exposures.title: Deleting an order from your history does not delete it
exposures.whatItMeans: Deleting an order removes it from your orders tab and ends any support you can get on it, but the order remains in Zomato's records under the privacy policy. Zomato also disclaims responsibility if the deleted order remains traceable through email, SMS, your bank statement, or a restaurant or delivery partner contacting you directly.
exposures.whyItMatters: The control reads as deletion and functions as hiding. Its only real effect on you is losing the ability to raise a complaint about that order, while the record Zomato holds is unchanged.

exposures.title: Meal subscriptions put dietary risk entirely on you
exposures.whatItMeans: For the meal-plan subscription, Zomato states it is not responsible for preparation, ingredient sourcing or nutritional claims, advises anyone with health conditions, food allergies or medical requirements to consult a doctor first, and states that by subscribing you assume all risks associated with dietary changes. Meals already in 'Order scheduled' status cannot be cancelled and are charged in full.
exposures.whyItMatters: A recurring meal plan is bought precisely for its nutritional claims. Disclaiming those claims while charging for the plan leaves the customer paying for a promise the contract says was never made.

availableActions.action: Escalate to the named Grievance Officer — Zomato actually gives you one
availableActions.howTo: Order issues go to app chat, then order@zomato.com, which generates a ticket number, then 011 41171852. With that ticket number you can escalate to the Grievance Officer, Swati Chauhan, at grievance@zomato.com or 011 41171443, Monday to Friday 9am-6pm, for a response within 48 hours. A Nodal Officer, Ashwat Kumar, is separately named at nodal@zomato.com. This is the most complete grievance disclosure in the corpus and the only route in the document that carries a committed timeline.

availableActions.action: Answer the courier's call — silence is billed at the order value
availableActions.howTo: Being unresponsive, unreachable or unavailable is expressly an Authorization Breach carrying liquidated damages equal to the order value, recovered from your next order. Check the delivery address and phone number before confirming, for the same reason.

availableActions.action: Photograph the problem before you complain
availableActions.howTo: Any complaint — spillage, a foreign object, the wrong order, poor quality — requires proof before a resolution is considered, and even then the restaurant must permit it. Evidence gathered at the door is the only leverage in the process.

availableActions.action: Claim the On Time Promise coupon within its short life
availableActions.howTo: A late order at a participating restaurant earns an INR 100 coupon, valid three days from generation (four days under the separate On Time Delivery scheme). It is void if you edited or cancelled the order, if it was bulk, scheduled or cash on delivery, or if it fell in peak hours. The clock stops when the courier is within 100 metres or reaches the security gate, not when you get the food.

deadline.description: The coupon expires three days from generation under On Time Promise, four days under On Time Delivery.

availableActions.action: Act inside one year of any harm
availableActions.howTo: The contractual limitation period is one year from when the harm initially occurred, not from when you discovered it, and it purports to override the statutory period. Anything you might litigate has to be started inside that window.

deadline.description: One year from when the alleged harm initially occurs, after which claims on those facts are stated to be barred.

availableActions.action: Do not send Zomato your ideas
availableActions.howTo: The terms ask you not to, and then state that anything you send anyway becomes Zomato's property with no compensation. Ordinary product feedback carries a perpetual global licence and a waiver of all claims. There is no version of this exchange where you keep anything.

availableActions.action: Check the Gold partner list and exclusion days before relying on the membership
availableActions.howTo: Partner restaurants, exclusion days and minimum order values all change at Zomato's discretion and are only published on the platform. Members are told to check before ordering or visiting. Enquire with the restaurant directly as well — honouring the benefit is the restaurant's obligation, not Zomato's.

availableActions.action: Get consent before sending a Zomato Gift, because you carry the liability
availableActions.howTo: Placing a gift order means warranting that you obtained the recipient's consent to hand over their name, phone number and address, and indemnifying Zomato against any claim they bring. You also undertake to be responsible for any refusal by the recipient, and any refund goes to you rather than them.

availableActions.action: Cancel a meal-plan meal more than two hours before its slot
availableActions.howTo: Meals can be cancelled or rescheduled through the platform up to two hours before the delivery slot; after that they are non-refundable. Cancelling the subscription itself applies prospectively and does not stop meals already in 'Order scheduled' status, which are delivered and charged in full.

deadline.description: At least two hours before the next scheduled meal delivery slot.

availableActions.action: Delete the account through Profile > Settings > Security
availableActions.howTo: Account deletion is available in-app or via the Contact Us link. Note that Zomato reserves the right to retain all data collected from your use of the services if it considers you used them in violation of the terms.

reference.label: Termination of your access to the services

requiredDisclosures.name: Named Grievance Officer
requiredDisclosures.note: The most complete in the corpus. Grievance Officer named as Swati Chauhan with postal address, email, phone and office hours, a separate named Nodal Officer, a tiered escalation path with ticket numbers, and a 48-hour response commitment — with the IT Act 2000 and Consumer Protection Act 2019 cited as the basis.

requiredDisclosures.name: Notice of changes to terms
requiredDisclosures.note: No notice of any kind. Zomato may amend the terms entirely at its own discretion, the customer is made responsible for checking the page, and continued use is deemed express acceptance.

requiredDisclosures.name: Governing law and jurisdiction
requiredDisclosures.note: Per-country: India under Indian law with exclusive jurisdiction in New Delhi; UAE in Dubai; Lebanon in Beirut; United States under Washington State law with exclusive jurisdiction in Seattle. No arbitration clause and no class-action waiver anywhere in the document.

requiredDisclosures.name: Refund and cancellation rights
requiredDisclosures.note: Disclosed and almost entirely adverse: no resolution without the restaurant's permission, platform fees never refunded, proof required for every complaint, no refund where order instructions were not followed, and liquidated damages payable if you cancel.

requiredDisclosures.name: Company identification details
requiredDisclosures.note: Legal entity name, CIN, registered and corporate addresses, website and app names, and a contact email — the identification an Indian intermediary is required to publish.

requiredDisclosures.name: Automatic renewal disclosure
requiredDisclosures.note: The meal-plan subscription is described as recurring, cancellable through 'manage plan', with cancellation applying prospectively and scheduled meals still charged. Zomato Gold is described as a plan valid until expiry, with no automatic-renewal mechanic stated.

requiredDisclosures.name: Repeat infringer policy
requiredDisclosures.note: A copyright notification procedure with the required good-faith and penalty-of-perjury statements, sent to legal@zomato.com, and a stated discretion to terminate repeat infringers.

requiredDisclosures.name: Consumer rights preservation
requiredDisclosures.note: The Consumer Protection Act 2019 is invoked to characterise the delivery partner rather than Zomato as your counterparty, and to establish the grievance mechanism — but nothing preserves the non-excludable consumer rights that the one-year limitation period and the personal-injury exclusion would otherwise override.

requiredDisclosures.name: Synthetic content declaration
requiredDisclosures.note: Users must truthfully declare whether uploaded audio content is synthetically generated, with a false declaration treated as a material breach — one of the few AI-labelling obligations in the corpus, though it binds the user rather than the platform.

analyses.summary: Canva's privacy policy is unusually forthcoming — it names its advertising partners (LiveRamp, Outbrain, Taboola, Appsflyer, Facebook, Google, TikTok, Samsung televisions), publishes a complete list of the twenty-one subprocessors that touch student data including OpenAI, keeps designs private by default, and offers working opt-outs for AI training, third-party enrichment and email matching. What it collects around that is wide. It buys your job title, seniority, employer and industry from data providers and combines them with what it observes; it names spending, occupation and employer among the inputs to predictions it makes about you; and if you are not a subscriber at all it may take your contact details from LinkedIn or a data broker to market to you. Retention is a commercially reasonable time. Information may be sold or transferred to third parties during the due diligence phase of a possible merger — before any deal exists. And the US section discloses that telling your employer whether someone uses Canva on their email domain is itself treated as a sale or sharing you can opt out of.

exposures.title: Canva builds a marketing profile of you before you are a user
exposures.whatItMeans: If you are not a Canva subscriber, Canva may obtain your contact details from a social media platform such as LinkedIn or from a third-party data provider in order to promote its subscriptions to you. It may also have obtained your details from another Canva user, for example when they shared a design with you.
exposures.whyItMatters: This is the pattern the corpus found at Robinhood, OpenAI, Flipkart and Google — a record about someone who never signed up — here used directly for outbound marketing. The opt-out exists but requires knowing Canva holds your details in the first place.

reference.label: 1(c) Information we receive from other third parties

exposures.title: Your job title, seniority and employer are bought and matched to you
exposures.whatItMeans: Canva obtains company, company size, job title, seniority and industry from public sources, social platforms and data providers, and states it may share your email address with those providers to obtain and combine that information with what it already holds. Some providers combine data collected through cookies and pixels with email or mailing addresses they already have.
exposures.whyItMatters: Your email address is sent outward in order to enrich the profile inward, so the matching happens at a third party. The legitimate-interests section confirms what the profile is for: spending, platform usage, occupation and employer feed predictions, decisions and offers.

exposures.title: AI training on your designs is on unless you turn it off
exposures.whatItMeans: Canva analyses your activity, content and media uploads to train its algorithms, models and AI products using machine learning, and stores derived data as Memories. Both are managed through settings pages, and Canva Education content is excluded from AI training entirely.
exposures.whyItMatters: The control is genuine and specifically located, which puts Canva ahead of Google and Walmart on this point. But it operates as an opt-out — the analysis is described as what Canva does, with the setting offered as a way to stop it — so the default state applies to everything already uploaded.

reference.label: 2. How we use your information — For Service improvement

exposures.title: Your data can be sold during due diligence on a deal that never happens
exposures.whatItMeans: Canva may share, sell or transfer information to third parties in connection with or in contemplation of a merger, acquisition, reorganisation, financing, sale of assets, bankruptcy or insolvency — expressly including as part of the due diligence process. Customer names, email addresses and User Content are named as among the items that may be transferred.
exposures.whyItMatters: Most such clauses attach to a completed transaction. This one reaches the exploratory phase, so your designs and contact details can go to a prospective acquirer that walks away, and the notification commitment is framed around a transaction taking place.

reference.label: 3(c) Sharing in connection with a merger, acquisition or reorganisation
reference.quote: in connection with or contemplation of (including as part of the due diligence process) any merger, acquisition, reorganisation, financing, sale of assets, bankruptcy or insolvency event

exposures.title: Telling your employer you use Canva counts as a sale
exposures.whatItMeans: The US rights section lists, among the disclosures a resident may opt out of as selling or sharing, Canva providing your employer with information confirming whether or not you use Canva using their email domain.
exposures.whyItMatters: The disclosure is candid and the opt-out is real, but the underlying practice is that signing up with a work address can surface you to your employer as a user before any account takeover occurs. Read with the Administered Account provisions, the work email address is the single riskiest choice in the product.

exposures.title: Your employer can take the account and everything in it
exposures.whatItMeans: An account created with an employer or organisation email is an Administered Account. Canva may share your name, email and account activity with that organisation and give it control, after which its administrator may access, transfer and control the account and all content and designs, change billing and privacy preferences, alter folder permissions, and delete the account.
exposures.whyItMatters: The privacy policy states Canva will provide advance notice so you can move content to a personal account; the terms of use promise only reasonable efforts to do so. Two documents from the same company, updated within a week of each other, describe the same protection at different strengths.
